comments.author: Guilder
comments.body:
Part of the Records of Study of Numbers Memorial Album, this is created using Sophia points obtained from Legacy theme discoveries. Requires Transmutation Alchemy Equipment or Complex Alchemy Equipment furniture. Recipe:

Base item: Silver Ring
Handicrafts/Alchemy R11
Sophia points consumed per production: 1200

Ingredients:
Element of Wisdom x2
White Alchemy Ointment x1
Ventus Reduction x10
20% chance of success

As with all Transmutation Alchemy recipes, Book of Uroboros items work fine. Sadly, Book of the Wingless Dragon do not.
